question: What practice is enjoined for one who, after six months, takes up the ochre robe described as free from bondage?
premises: A time limit of six months is specified.
One who takes up the ochre robe, described as free from bondage, is indicated.
inference: From six months onward, one who has taken up the ochre robe free from bondage should practice.
uncertainties: The object and specific method of practice are not named by these tokens.
plain_english: Whoever, after six months, should practice, having taken up the ochre robe free from bondage.
